title: ColecoVision cartridge
description: A cartridge as it sits from $8000, written from the start address and the vectors the BIOS jumps through (start, rst08 .. rst30, irq, nmi). The header ($AA55 / $55AA, the five table pointers, the title) is data, said in the head comment.
